card.title: Try It First
card.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Turn the kitchen tap on before I start washing up. I've tightened the loose joint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wear my apron. I need to know whether the joint holds.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You wear it and turn the tap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll need it dry for washing up. You can have my raincoat for the test.

mechanism: A makes B test a repaired tap before A does the washing, bargaining over protective clothes to keep the exposure with B.
confusable: Unlike asking for repair help, A must preserve B as the first tester of the uncertain fix.
comparison: D32-a offers rain protection while staying dry; D32-b offers compensation for tasting a coffee substitute first.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
